section.title: Loading the exchange rates
section.scenario: A money transfer app converts amounts between currencies using a table of rates. Finance updates the table once a week, and it ships with each release.
section.question: The rates file is bundled with the app and read from the server's own disk once, when the app boots. Which piece should load it, and which stated fact decides it?
section.piece_a:
class ExchangeRates
  PATH = Rails.root.join("config/exchange_rates.yml")

  def self.load
    YAML.safe_load_file(PATH).transform_values(&:to_d)
  end
end
section.piece_b:
class ExchangeRates
  PATH = Rails.root.join("config/exchange_rates.yml")
  ATTEMPTS = 3

  def self.load
    attempts = 0
    begin
      attempts += 1
      YAML.safe_load_file(PATH).transform_values(&:to_d)
    rescue Errno::EIO
      retry if attempts < ATTEMPTS
      raise
    end
  end
end
